description:
Title: Contract

For your contract project you need parts from several web shops.
In order to find out which web shop has the right parts, you have to query them all, and find out how much they can deliver, at which price, and how long it will take.
Create a list of parts that you order from each shop.
If one shop has not enough  parts, order from several shops.
Always use the cheapest parts.
The parts arrive in batches in a random order, typically they are +/- 2 days earlier/later.
When the first parts arrive you start building.
Sometimes you have to reorder parts.
If your stock (for a single part) falls below 5, you reorder (the cheapest), if it falls below 3 you reorder again (the fastest).
If it is zero, you write a mail to your friends, complaining about the webshops.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Contract" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/contract">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Contract" name="Contract" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_PartsNeeded" name="Parts needed for contract project"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_QueryShops" name="Query web shops for quantity, price and delivery time"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompareOffers" name="Compare offers"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateOrderList" name="Create list of parts to order from each shop"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OneShopSufficient" name="Enough parts at one shop?" default="Flow_OneShopNo"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderOneShop" name="Order all parts from one shop (cheapest parts)"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderSeveralShops" name="Order parts from several shops (cheapest parts)"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrdersMerge" name="Orders placed"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_BatchesSplit" name="Parts batches start arriving"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch" name="Receive first parts batch"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_ReceiveRemainingBatches" name="Receive remaining parts batches"/>
    <bpmn:complexGateway id="Gateway_FirstPartsArrived" name="First parts arrived" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildWithParts" name="Build with arrived parts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckStock" name="Check stock level of each part"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AnyPartBelow5" name="Stock of any part below 5?" default="Flow_NoPartBelow5"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockLevel" name="Stock level of the part?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder part (fastest parts)"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder part (cheapest parts)"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_ReceiveReorderedParts" name="Receive reordered parts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WriteComplaintMail" name="Write mail to friends complaining about web shops"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_StockSufficient" name="Stock sufficient"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ComplaintSent" name="Complaint mail sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_PartsNeeded" targetRef="Task_QueryShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Task_CompareOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_CompareOffers" targetRef="Task_CreateOrderList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_CreateOrderList" targetRef="Gateway_OneShopSufficient"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OneShopYes" sourceRef="Gateway_OneShopSufficient" targetRef="Task_OrderOneShop">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${oneShopSufficient == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OneShopNo" sourceRef="Gateway_OneShopSufficient" targetRef="Task_OrderSeveralShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_OrderOneShop" targetRef="Gateway_OrdersMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_OrderSeveralShops" targetRef="Gateway_OrdersMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Gateway_OrdersMerge" targetRef="Gateway_BatchesSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_BatchesSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_BatchesSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRemainingBatches"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch" targetRef="Gateway_FirstPartsArrived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRemainingBatches" targetRef="Gateway_FirstPartsArrived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_FirstPartsArrived" targetRef="Task_BuildWithParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_BuildWithParts" targetRef="Task_CheckStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_CheckStock" targetRef="Gateway_AnyPartBelow5"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AnyPartBelow5" sourceRef="Gateway_AnyPartBelow5" targetRef="Gateway_StockLevel">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${anyPartStockBelow5 == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoPartBelow5" sourceRef="Gateway_AnyPartBelow5" targetRef="End_StockSufficient"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockZero" sourceRef="Gateway_StockLevel" targetRef="Task_WriteComplaintMail">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stockLevelOfPart == 0}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockBelow3" sourceRef="Gateway_StockLevel" targetRef="Task_ReorderFastest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stockLevelOfPart > 0 && stockLevelOfPart < 3}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockBelow5" sourceRef="Gateway_StockLevel" targetRef="Task_ReorderCheapest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stockLevelOfPart >= 3 && stockLevelOfPart < 5}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReorderFastestDone" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Task_ReceiveReorderedParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReorderCheapestDone" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Task_ReceiveReorderedParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReorderedArrived" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveReorderedParts" targetRef="Task_CheckStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MailSent" sourceRef="Task_WriteComplaintMail" targetRef="End_ComplaintSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="Diagram_Contract">
    <bpmndi:BPMNPlane id="Plane_Contract" bpmnElement="Process_Contract"/>
  </bpmndi:BPMNDiagram>
</bpmn:definitions>
